name: fieldseal-demo-patient-directory
description: The Prisma half of the fieldseal patient-directory demo. Not a package, not a starter template: it exists to prove one claim about bytes in a shared database.
//: Both local packages are declared explicitly, at paths relative to THIS
package. npm's history of resolving a nested relative `file:` spec
against the root project rather than the declaring package is long and
version-dependent, and this demo hands a core-constructed
StaticKeyProvider to the adapter -- so two copies of the core would
typecheck as two unrelated types even though they would work at runtime.
A `file:` dependency is recorded in the lockfile with `"link": true` and
no integrity hash. `npm ci` here is a reproducible *resolution*, not a
supply-chain claim: it links the working tree beside it.
@prisma/client, prisma and @prisma/adapter-pg are pinned to exactly the
version the adapter is verified against. The adapter's peer range is
>=7.10.0 <8 and npm auto-installs peers, so an unpinned demo would drift
off it silently -- and the `prisma` CLI's `latest` tag currently points
